title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Environmental Responsibility and Academic Reading
prompt: Some people argue that environmental protection is primarily the responsibility of governments and large corporations, while individuals can do little to make a difference. Others believe that individual actions, when combined, are essential for meaningful environmental progress. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your essay, consider the role of personal habits such as consumption, recycling, and transport choices, as well as the influence of policy and corporate practice. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场。建议用约40分钟完成，写至少250词。文章结构可包括：引言（引出话题并表明立场）、主体段1（讨论政府与企业应负主要责任的观点）、主体段2（讨论个人行动重要的观点）、结论（总结并重申个人观点）。注意使用学术语气，避免口语化表达，并用具体例子支持论点，但例子应基于常识或合理推断，无需引用真实统计数据。
